panels.title: Encoded JSON body observations
panels.description: Unit: observations. Population: memwal_http_response_body_bytes. This is encoded JSON length, not wire bytes and not client receipt. A missing series means the process has not registered the histogram.

panels.title: Body-byte p50 p90 p99
panels.description: Unit: bytes. histogram_quantile on the process histogram. Not account-level and not node egress. Do not average percentiles.
